sloka: तेन शब्देन महता लङ्का समभिपूरिता ।सपर्वतवना सर्वा सो ऽपि नैव प्रबुध्यते ।। ६.६०.४८ ।।।।
transliteration: tena śabdena mahatā laṅkā samabhipūritā ।saparvatavanā sarvā so 'pi naiva prabudhyate ।। 6.60.48 ।।।।

translations.english: Wrapped in sleep like that because of the spell of the curse, he had not wakened. The Rakshasas got enraged.
